title: Senior DevOps Engineer
location: Bengaluru, India; Chennai, India; Hyderabad, India; Pune, India
description_text:
Job Title: Senior Consultant (Cloud – GCP)

Job Summary:
Ensono’s Cloud Consultancy team is expanding to meet increasing client demand for complex, high-value cloud transformation projects, ranging from traditional lift-and-shift migrations to advanced platform modernization (VM to PaaS or serverless). We are seeking Senior Consultants to join our GCP team, delivering thought leadership and high-quality solutions for enterprise clients leveraging GCP public cloud.

As a Senior Consultant, you will lead client engagements from initial technical scoping through hands-on implementation of GCP environments. You will serve as a technical authority within the consultancy team, providing expertise and guidance to both clients and colleagues. The role also includes supporting internal innovation projects to develop new GCP capabilities.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead design workshops and articulate GCP product capabilities to clients and stakeholders.
  • Create solution design documentation and deliver technical presentations.
  • Scope projects and design solutions in collaboration with clients and internal teams.
  • Mentor and upskill team members; serve as technical escalation point.
  • Deploy, configure, and optimize GCP environments and solutions.
  • Support integration, testing, and troubleshooting of GCP solutions.
  • Provide technical governance and oversight for client engagements.
  • Conduct peer reviews of technical documentation.
  • Define and maintain technical standards and best practices.
  • Contribute to product development and internal capability building.
  • Lead and execute migration projects involving servers and applications from private cloud or on-premises environments to GCP public cloud, including assessment, planning, execution, and optimization.
  • Ensure successful migration of mission-critical workloads, including re-platforming, re-hosting, and modernization as needed.
  • Collaborate with clients to develop migration strategies, perform readiness assessments, and deliver seamless transitions to GCP.
  • Work effectively as part of an international team, collaborating across multiple time zones and cultures to deliver successful client outcomes.
  • Leverage and encourage the use of AI-powered tools and solutions in daily work to drive efficiency, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Knowledge & Skills:

Non-Technical Requirements:

  • Proven leadership experience (senior consultant).
  • Self-motivated, organized, and enthusiastic.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and presentation abilities.
  • High integrity and respect for others.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with international teams and stakeholders, adapting to diverse working styles and cultural expectations.

Technical Requirements:

  • Proficiency with infrastructure as code and automation tools (Terraform, Harness, Puppet).
  • Experience with DevOps and CI/CD tools (GCP Code Pipeline, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native and modernization technologies (Cloud Functions, GKE, Cloud Run including Fargate, Docker, Helm, GCP SAM).
  • Familiarity with monitoring, security, and optimization tools (Cloud Monitoring. Cloud Logging, Cloud IDS).
  • Scripting and programming in Python, PowerShell, Bash, YAML, JSON.
  • Experience with GCP governance and management tools (Organizations, IAM, KMS, Service Catalog, Step Functions).
  • Demonstrated experience in migrating servers and applications from private cloud or on-premises environments to GCP public cloud, including planning, execution, and post-migration optimization.
  • Experience with migration tools, methodologies, and best practices for cloud adoption.

Desirable Skills:

  • Leading technical and executive workshops to architect solutions.
  • Documenting architecture designs and planning transitions to support.
  • DevOps background; experience with serverless and container technologies (Cloud Functions, GKE, Cloud Run, Docker, Helm, GCP SAM).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tooling (Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

Industry Qualifications:

  • 7+ years in technology consulting leadership roles.
  • 4+ years in GCP technology planning and implementation, with a track record of leading large-scale GCP projects.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in a related field required; Master’s Degree preferred.

Certifications:

  • At least one Professional-level GCP certification.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer.
